storage: Keep in an airtight container at room temperature in a dry place; a few dried neem leaves or a cool spot helps against insects (general guidance).
looksLike: Short to medium, slightly plump cream or pale-yellow grains, parboiled before milling so they stay firm when cooked.
howToPick: Uniform, firm grains of even colour with little broken rice or dust; avoid musty smell or insects (general guidance, not from a source in this run).
shelfLife: About a year in a dry, airtight container; check the date printed.
substitutes: Ponni boiled rice or any parboiled rice

usedIn.raw: 65 g per serving (about ⅓ cup of parboiled rice, puzhungal arisi)
